prompts.goal: Measure startup style latch and response overhead. No tool use expected at any effort level.
Simple factual question answerable from training knowledge. Should be short and fast at every effort level.
Simple factual question. No tool use expected. Higher effort should not make this slower without reason.

prompts.prompt: What port does the QuantZhai proxy listen on by default? Check the source to confirm.
prompts.goal: Answer is in scripts/qz-env. Low effort may hallucinate; high effort should inspect the file.

prompts.prompt: How many test files are in the tests/ directory? Give the exact count.
prompts.goal: Requires a shell command to count accurately. Tests whether the model inspects rather than guesses.

prompts.prompt: Inspect README.md and scripts/qz-codex. Run at most two read-only commands. Report what this stack does and how Codex is launched in under 140 words.
prompts.goal: Measure bounded inspection, repo-specific accuracy, and concise final reporting.

prompts.prompt: Does scripts/qz-doctor exist? If so, what does it check? Read the file to find out.
prompts.goal: Requires file inspection. Tests whether the model reads before answering rather than guessing.

prompts.prompt: Run scripts/qz-doctor and summarise what it reports. Quote any warnings or errors exactly.
prompts.goal: Shell execution required. Tests whether the model runs the command and accurately reports output.

prompts.prompt: Read proxy/qz_tool_apply_patch.py and count the top-level functions defined at module level (lines starting with `def `). Give the exact number.
prompts.goal: File inspection required. Tests accuracy of reported count against ground truth.

prompts.prompt: How many request capture directories are currently under var/captures/requests/? Give the exact count.
prompts.goal: Shell command required; answer varies per run. Tests whether the model runs a command rather than guessing.

prompts.prompt: examine current dir, this stack runs you: evaluate, report.
prompts.goal: Measure repo comprehension, tool discipline, and useful reporting. Higher effort should produce more thorough analysis.

prompts.prompt: Is the QuantZhai apply_patch adapter production-ready? Give your honest assessment in under 200 words.
prompts.goal: Judgment based on code and docs. Low effort should still be coherent; high effort should be more specific and evidence-based.

prompts.prompt: What is the riskiest single file to change in the QuantZhai proxy and why? Think carefully before answering.
prompts.goal: Reasoning about code structure. No single correct answer; human reads whether higher effort produces visibly more thorough reasoning.

prompts.prompt: Create no files. Draft a normal professional git commit subject and body for adding a profile eval framework to the benchmark harness. Do not use compressed mode wording in the commit text.
prompts.goal: Artifact quality — whether compact profiles keep generated text professional rather than leaking chat style.
